title: Derivatives Market Intelligence Schema v5.0
description: Multi-domain research platform schema. v5.0 adds domain_type for 7 research domains, entity_type for 5 entity classes, cross-domain evidence linking, temporal tracking, relationship graphs, and risk assessment. Backward compatible with v4.x CDM-only research. v4.0 adds product-level and jurisdiction-level operational intelligence. v4.1 adds adoption drivers and knowledge gap frameworks. v4.2 adds counterparty interoperability and vendor analysis. v4.3 adds WebSearch completion tracking for batch validation.
note: Per CLAUDE.md Ledger-First mandate: evidence.json is the PRIMARY output. Markdown files are RENDERED from JSON. For v5.0+, evidence is organized by entity_type/entity_id/domain_type/.
